title: Eggplant Schnitzel in Tomato Sauce
subtitle: roasted, crumbed and pan-fried, with parmesan and basil
description: Whole eggplants are roasted, peeled, then crumbed like a schnitzel and fried until golden, and served over a quick garlicky tomato sauce.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Prick the eggplants with a fork and place on a tray lined with baking paper. Roast for 45 minutes, turning every quarter of an hour so they cook evenly. Let cool slightly.
Gently peel the eggplants with a knife.
Dip each eggplant in flour, then egg and finally breadcrumbs, as for a schnitzel.
Heat oil in a deep pan. Fry the eggplants on both sides until golden and drain on a rack.
Make the sauce: fry the garlic for a few seconds and add the remaining sauce ingredients in order. Cook together, stirring, for 4 minutes. Taste and adjust the seasoning.
To serve: put a few spoonfuls of sauce on a serving plate and top with a fried eggplant. Grate over parmesan and scatter with fresh basil.
